resolvedThisSession.symptom: EBUSY/EPERM unlink spool-policy-* state.db(-shm) teardown failure recurring in subtest 2
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: Assertion drift masked by leaked handle: the 257MiB create was legal under the reviewed 10GiB ceiling, the failed a.rejects leaked the created service's open state DB handle, and the finally rm EBUSY replaced the real assertion error
resolvedThisSession.resolution: Test aligned to the pinned policy bound; legal create explicitly closed; teardown uses fs.rm maxRetries; 8/8 across repeated runs

resolvedThisSession.symptom: Drill reported EBUSY unlink of live/registry.db instead of its real failure
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: The cleanup block ran before handles were closed, so the Windows EBUSY from an open registry replaced the genuine assertion error (the workspace directory had not been created)
resolvedThisSession.resolution: Handles are tracked and closed in the finally before cleanup, the workspace directory is created up front, and the drill now reports real failures; 12 checks pass

resolvedThisSession.symptom: PostgreSQL 18.6 schema-migration conformance failed 5/5 live tests with UNMANAGED_CONSTRAINT BLOCKING entries
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: PostgreSQL 18 catalogues NOT NULL as pg_constraint (contype 'n'); the planner treated every non-primary constraint as unmanaged, so any NOT NULL column blocked add-column/cast/drop/PK migrations
resolvedThisSession.resolution: diffPostgresSchema skips 'n' (nullability is already in the column contract) and still blocks real unmanaged constraints; live PostgreSQL 18.6 conformance 55/55 with TLS verify-full; unit regression in tests/schema-migration.test.js

resolvedThisSession.symptom: MySQL source conformance returned 2026-02-28T23:36:07Z for a stored 2026-03-01 05:06:07 DATETIME on an IST host
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: DATETIME has no offset and mysql2 parsed it in the host process timezone, so migrated values shifted by the host offset (5h30m)
resolvedThisSession.resolution: mysqlConnectionConfig pins timezone 'Z'; live MySQL 8.4.13 source+target conformance 7/7 on the non-UTC host with TLS verify-full
resolvedThisSession.followUp: A repeat run against the same server exposed a non-idempotent test reset: it recreated only the data table, so the durable spool_batch_ledger/spool_execution_leases evidence from the previous run made the replay look like a ledger mismatch. The reset now deletes only that table's ledger and lease rows; 7/7 passes on a dirty server too, with no assertion relaxed.

resolvedThisSession.symptom: Image build repeatedly failed because the Docker engine died mid-build with 0.25-1.3 GB free on C:
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: Host disk exhaustion, not a Docker or Dockerfile defect: reclaiming temp/update caches restored the engine, and the build then completed with cache hits
resolvedThisSession.resolution: Image built at d2c1b94 (sha256:5a7c6207…, 532 642 879 B, non-root node, HEALTHCHECK), real HTTP lifecycle 20/20 checks in-container, restart persistence, kernel-level loopback-only listener, fail-closed config exits; scripts/qualify-container.js + docs/SELF_HOSTING.md runbook

resolvedThisSession.symptom: A fresh daemon deployment could never create a workspace: POST /v2/workspaces failed ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND and only tests could create an organization
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: The registry constructor API had no product surface; the daemon was provisioned only with a pre-existing registry.db
resolvedThisSession.resolution: POST /v2/organizations (platform root, registry required) with root-only RBAC; tests/api-v2.test.js covers creation, denial for API-key principals and immediate workspace usability; documented in docs/SELF_HOSTING.md

resolvedThisSession.symptom: High-severity dependency advisory GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 in @azure/msal-node (transitive via tedious/mssql and snowflake-sdk) failed npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
resolvedThisSession.rootCause: mssql and snowflake-sdk were listed as core production dependencies even though they are optional connectors, pulling in @azure/identity and vulnerable @azure/msal-node into the core production package closure
resolvedThisSession.resolution: Scoped optional drivers (mssql, snowflake-sdk) to devDependencies; introduced src/connectors/driver-loader.js with shape, major-version verification and fail-closed typed errors (CONNECTOR_DRIVER_*); updated static release check and added boundary tests; core production closure (npm audit --omit=dev) reports 0 vulnerabilities
